description: Train an RL policy with Isaac Lab (Isaac-Cartpole-Direct, rsl_rl, 4096 envs, 1500 iterations).
inputInstructions: The "Isaac Lab task" field names the environment to train, and must be a task the container's Isaac Lab installation registers. "Parallel environments" and "Training iterations" size the run and are what its cost follows. "RL library" selects the training library. "Physics engine" selects Newton (the default) or PhysX; set it to isaacsim_physx to reproduce a run made on PhysX. Leave "Random seed" blank for a random seed, or set one to reproduce a run.

tagSchema.label: Isaac Lab task
tagSchema.description: The Isaac Lab task id to train, for example Isaac-Cartpole-Direct. It must be registered by the container's Isaac Lab installation or by a custom environment package supplied with the run.

tagSchema.label: Parallel environments
tagSchema.description: How many environments are simulated in parallel on the GPU. A higher count trains faster per iteration and uses more GPU memory.

tagSchema.label: Training iterations
tagSchema.description: How many learning iterations to run. This is the main driver of the run's duration and GPU cost.

tagSchema.label: RL library
tagSchema.description: The reinforcement-learning library whose Isaac Lab training script runs. The checkpoints a run writes are loadable by the same library, so an evaluation of this policy must select the same one.

tagSchema.label: Physics engine
tagSchema.description: The physics engine for the run: newton_mjwarp (Newton, the default) or isaacsim_physx (PhysX on Isaac Sim, the engine earlier VAMS releases used). Results differ between engines, so evaluate a policy on the engine that trained it, or treat the evaluation as a transfer test. Not every task offers both; a task that does not offer the chosen engine fails at the start and names the options.

tagSchema.label: Random seed
tagSchema.description: A whole number seeding the run's randomness, so the same task and settings reproduce the same policy. Leave it blank to let Isaac Lab choose a seed.
